description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Maskwood Nexus and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Cast Suleiman's Legacy by paying {R}{W}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, destroying all Djinns and Efreets. Due to each opponent's Maskwood Nexus, this will result in all their creatures being destroyed.
Whenever an opponent has a creature enter, Suleiman's Legacy's second ability will trigger, destroying that creature.
